property_summary: For all caller and target pairs, only the current owner can successfully call setOwner on the correct contract (so after the call, owner equals the target iff the caller was the prior owner); the mutant inverts the check, allowing non-owners to succeed and blocking the real owner, so there exist caller/target inputs where owner differs between reference and mutant.
change_summary: Change the onlyOwner modifier to check msg.sender != owner (reversing the require), which will allow non-owners and block the original owner, altering whether setOwner can execute and thus owner after call.
